trigger: Socket.IO runs this handler when the connection closes (for example after `sock.close()`, or when the server drops the socket). It is not an event to emit.

request.note: The handler takes no argument. The call-cost limit does not apply to it (node/server.js:4939).

responses.name: Closed
responses.when: The socket is closed, so you get nothing. Each cleanup step has its own `try`/`catch`: an error in one step does not stop the others. Also sent lists what other clients get. When the socket has no character, or the character is marked `dc` already, the server only cancels a login in progress, removes the socket, and removes the observer of the socket (if any).

confirm.note: A `player.monster` (from `pet`) would get `remove_monster` and a `death` to clients nearby, but no code ever sets it (see `pet`)

also.to: everyone in the instance of the attacker
also.when: Not on a generated map, and a different character hit you recently (`s.block.f`): `defeat_player` gives that character the PvP kill and kills you. In the arena the `pvp` NPC also sends `chat_log`. On every disconnect outside generated maps, `player.violations` goes up by 1.
PvP kill only, when you are in a party: `rip` sends the party state to each member (you too, but your socket is closed).
also.summary: `{list, party}`: the names and the state of the party. See the `party_update` entry.

also.to: the other members of your party
also.when: You were in a party: `leave_party`. Each member also gets a `player` update (`resend "nc+u+cid"`).
also.summary: A `LocalizedText` (`server.party.left`) with `leave: 1`, `list` (the new party, or `false`) and `party`.

confirm.note: `list` is `false` and `party` is `{}` when fewer than 2 members are left

also.when: Always for a character, after the party step.

confirm.note: Clients that had you in view (`seen`), or in the same instance and in range

also.when: You had a poker seat: the seat is marked `dc`. It stays for 5 min (`grace_ms`), plays 2 hands by the clock, then sits out. Before this, the server returns your open dice stakes to your gold, and settles a wheel spin or a slots pull at once with no messages.
also.summary: The public state, with `dc: true` on your seat.

confirm.live_needed: The grace time and the hands come from `G.games.poker` (`grace_ms` 300000, `blind_hands` 2 in G 17478); the live G may differ.

order: PvP kill only: `server_message` to the instance of the attacker (and `chat_log` in the arena), then `party_update` to your party
party only: `party_update` and `player` to each other member
poker seat only: `poker` state to the tavern
